data.title: Humanoid Global Portfolio Firm Powers New Australian Automation Platform

data.title: MPS Moves Closer to ADI BPO Merger as NCLT Clears Key Step
data.description:
MPS Limited ( (IN:MPSLTD) ) has shared an update.

MPS Limited has reported a key procedural development in its planned amalgamation with ADI BPO Services Limited, as the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) in Chennai has passed an order on the company’s second motion petition under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act. The order records that equity shareholders and unsecured creditors of MPS approved the scheme in meetings held on 22 August 2026, with the secured creditors’ meeting earlier dispensed with by the tribunal.

The NCLT has directed that notices be served to relevant statutory and regulatory authorities to invite any representations on the amalgamation scheme, marking progress toward final approval of the merger. MPS has made the tribunal’s order available on its website and notified stock exchanges promptly after receiving the certified copy, signaling ongoing transparency for investors and other stakeholders as it advances the consolidation with ADI BPO Services Limited.

data.title: HMOBI Secures Control of Lamsa Through R$229 Million Capital Increase
data.description:
Hmobi Participacoes SA ( (BR:HMOB3) ) just unveiled an update.

HMOBI Participações S.A. gained control of Linha Amarela S.A. (Lamsa) after shareholders approved a capital increase funded by its controlling shareholder, Mubadala Capital IAV Fundo de Investimento em Participações Multiestratégia. The contribution consisted of shares representing about 60.3% of Lamsa’s total and voting capital, reinforcing HMOBI’s presence in infrastructure concessions.

The capital increase, valued at approximately R$229.2 million, was executed under a pre-existing contribution and voting agreement among shareholders. HMOBI stated that its shareholders will amend their shareholders’ agreement to formalize Lamsa’s status as a subsidiary and ensure the new shares subscribed by Mubadala Capital do not dilute the political and liquidity rights of minority investors.
